regions.full_page: June Ist 1917 First Friday Early First Communion "Suffer the Little Children to come to me and forbid -not" It is the ardent desire of the Church and of the Sacred Heart of Jesus Himself that frequently and with great zeal we be reminded of the untold treas- ures of Holy Communion. The general intention for this month, "Early Ist Communion" is a phase of this subject which, in the interest of the Sacred Heart and of the little children we will briefly consider this evening. "Suffer the little children . What a beautiful expression and how tender! What an authorative ring to these words of our Divine Master! They contain at once a command, an appeal, an ex- hortation. "Suffer the little · Nor can we be surprised that Jesus speaks with such spirit in this connection - in connection with the very lambs of His flock. The greatest characters of every nation and of every age - men and women alike - have been friends of the children, have loved them, have pro- tected them, have espoused the cause of the little children and shall Jesus be less loving, less af- fectionate? Their very weakness appeals to every noble heart. Their innocence, their candor, their simplicity, their disposition to love and to for- give inspires sympathy and parental solicitude wherever a spark of humanity is left. But more than this; every one knows that the future of society depends on the children of Today. If the saying is true that "the boy is father to the man," then we likewise say that "the little children are the parents of youth." If child-hood be sanctified as Jesus would sanctify it, youth can not but be holy. If youth is holy man-hood will surely be noble - and vice versa. As the lily or the rose unprotected in the bud will bloom forth - if it blooms at all .- will bloom forth blighted in every petal, so with men and women whose child-hood has been neglected, whose youth has been spoiled. "As the sprig is bent so shall it grow." And we may add here, as believers in eternal reward and punishment - "as the tree is inclined so shall it fall." Man was created not simply and solly for society. He was created for Heaven as well. "God made me ... " If I fail in this
